name: I-asthma ebantwaneni
sources: Inkqubo yeSizwe yeMfundo yeMbefu yoMzantsi Afrika

urgent.heading: Ungxamisekile - fowuna ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Sebenzisa i-inhaler eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka yokukhulula ukuphefumla kunye ne-spacer. Ukuba akukho phuculo kwimizuzu eyi-10-tsalela umnxeba u-10177.
red_flags: Ukuphefumla kakhulu ukuthetha izivakalisi ezipheleleyo, okanye ukukhala
Imilebe, iinzipho, okanye ubuso buba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okanye bungwevu
Ulusu lufunxa phakathi okanye ngaphantsi kweembambo ngomphefumlo ngamnye
Ukhohlokhohlo olunzima kakhulu umntwana akakwazi ukuyeka okanye ukulala
Isifuba esithe cwaka - umoya uyayeka kuba umoya uphantsi kakhulu

what_is_it.heading: Isifuba somoya sabantwana ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-asthma kuxa imigudu yomoya emiphungeni iba novakalelo kwaye idumbe - iyaqina kwaye ikhuphe i-mucus ekuphenduleni izinto ezibangela ukuba kube nzima kumntwana ukuphefumla.
paragraphs: Isifuba somoya sabantwana sesinye sezona meko zixhaphakileyo ezingapheliyo kubantwana baseMzantsi Afrika - malunga nomntwana om-1 kwabali-10. Iimpawu zinokuza kwaye zihambe. Ngonyango olululo, uninzi lwabantwana abane-asthma banokuphila, badlale imidlalo, kwaye balale ngokuqhelekileyo.

Abantwana abanesifo sombefu badla ngokufuna iindidi ezimbini zamayeza: isixhobo sokuphefumla (esidla ngokuba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka) ngexesha lohlaselo, kunye nesithinteli sokuphefumla (esidla ngokuba mdaka) esisetyenziswa yonke imihla ukugcina iindlela zomoya zizolile. Umthinteli nguye ogcina umntwana ephuma esibhedlele - nokuba uziva ephilile.

items.headline: 1 ku10
items.body: Abantwana baseMzantsi Afrika banesifo sombefu - uninzi lwabo abakhange lufunyanwe, ingakumbi abo banokhohlokhohlo olungapheliyo ebusuku.

items.headline: Iinhalers ezimbini
items.body: I-Blue reliever yokuhlaselwa, i-brown preventer yonke imihla. Umthinteli nguye olawula esi sifo.

items.headline: Ngalo lonke ixesha
items.body: Abantwana kufuneka bahlale besebenzisa i-spacer kunye ne-inhaler yabo. Iphinda kabini isixa samayeza afikelela emiphungeni.

items.headline: Izinto ezibangelayo ziyahluka
items.body: Izinto eziqhelekileyo ezibangela: ukubanda kwentsholongwane, uthuli, umsi, i-pet dander, umoya obandayo, umthambo. Ukwazi izinto ezibangela umntwana wakho akwazi ukuthintela ukuhlaselwa.

pull_quote.text: Uninzi lohlaselo lwesifuba somntwana olubi ngokwaneleyo esibhedlele lwalunokuthintelwa ngokusetyenziswa kwe-inhaler yokuthintela yonke imihla. Musa ukuyiyeka ngenxa yokuba umntwana uziva ephilile—yiloo nto ekumele ukuba yenziwe.

signs.heading: Iimpawu eziqhelekileyo ze-asthma yobuntwana
signs.lede: Umbefu awusoloko ukhangeleka ngathi uyatswina. Ebantwaneni ngakumbi, ukhohlokhohlo olomileyo oluthatha ixesha elide - ngakumbi ebusuku okanye ngokwenza umthambo - luhlala luphawu lweenyanga ngaphambi kokuxilongwa.

items.title: Ukhohlokhohlo olungasukiyo
items.description: Ngokukodwa ebusuku, kusasa, okanye ngokubaleka nokudlala. Olona phawu luxhaphakileyo ebantwaneni - kaninzi abaphoswa ziinyanga 'njengomkhuhlane omane ubuya'.

items.title: Ukuphefumla okanye ukuphefumla okungxolayo
items.description: Isandi somlozi, ngakumbi xa uphefumlela ngaphandle. Ngamanye amaxesha kuphela ngexesha lokubanda, ngamanye amaxesha kunye naluphi na ukunyamezela.

items.title: Ukuphefumula okufutshane, isifuba esiqinileyo
items.description: Umntwana uhlala e-PE, akakwazi ukuhlala noontanga bakhe, ukhalaza ukuba isifuba siziva siqinile okanye 'sibuhlungu'. Kufanelekile ukuphandwa.

items.fact: Abaninzi bayayenza—kodwa abaninzi abakwenzi oko. Nokuba iimpawu zihleli, ubuntununtunu bomoya bunokubuya nangabuphi na ubudala. Gcina isithinteli sihamba njengoko kumiselweyo, nokuba kulungile.

Idosi kwizithinteli eziphefumlelweyo iphantsi kakhulu kwaye isebenza kwindawo emiphungeni. Nasiphi na impembelelo encinci ekukhuleni ayinabungozi kakhulu kunesifuba esilawulwa kakubi. I-Oral steroids ngexesha lohlaselo inefuthe elingakumbi-yiyo ke loo nto kubalulekile ukuthintela.

Isifuba somoya esilawulwa kakuhle akufuneki sithintele ezemidlalo. Iimbaleki ezininzi zeOlimpiki zinesifuba. Ukuba umntwana wakho akakwazi ukuhambisana noontanga bakhe, isifo sombefu asilawuleki — thetha nekliniki.
I-blue reliever yeyeentsuku zokugula. Isithinteli esimdaka kufuneka sisetyenziswe yonke imihla - nokuba kulungile. Ukuyitsiba kuvumela ukuvuvukala kwakhe, okukhokelela ekuhlaselweni.

items.title: Fumana isicwangciso sokusebenza sombefu ekliniki
items.description: Isicwangciso esibhaliweyo sikuxelela ngokuthe ngqo into omawuyenze kwinqanaba ngalinye - eluhlaza (elungileyo), etyheli (eya iba mandundu), ebomvu (engxamisekileyo). Isimahla, isayinwe ngugqirha wakho okanye umongikazi.

items.title: Ngalo lonke ixesha sebenzisa i-spacer kunye ne-inhaler
items.description: I-Spaces iphinda kabini inani lamayeza afikelela emiphungeni. Zisimahla kwiikliniki. Musa ukuvumela umntwana ukuba asebenzise i-inhaler ngaphandle kweyodwa.

items.title: Nika isithinteli yonke imihla, lonke ixesha lonyaka
items.description: Umkhuseli weBrown (okanye inhaler edibeneyo) kabini ngosuku, yonke imihla. Naxa umntwana eziva ephilile. Nasehlotyeni. Ukutsiba ngoyena nobangela wohlaselo.

items.title: Zazi izinto ezibangela umntwana wakho acinge
items.description: Gcina amanqaku kwizinto ezizisa iimpawu. Ezona ziqhelekileyo: iintsholongwane ezibandayo, uthuli, umsi (kuquka ibraai), iikati, izinja, umoya obandayo, umthambo. Nciphisa into onokuyenza.

items.title: Xelela isikolo kunye nokhathalelo lwasemva
items.description: Banike ikopi yesicwangciso sokusebenza kunye ne-spare reliever inhaler nge-spacer. Uninzi lwezikolo luyawamkela la maxwebhu nje ukuba amaphepha asayiniwe.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Isifuba somoya sabantwana siyanyangeka ngokupheleleyo kwinkqubo karhulumente yaseMzantsi Afrika. Iinhalers, izikhewu, kunye nezicwangciso zokwenza zonke zisimahla kwiikliniki.
